points.label: Title wording
points.left: Genesis calls Melchizedek king of Salem and priest of God Most High
points.right: Hebrews explains the names as king of righteousness and king of peace

points.label: Source of explanation
points.left: Melchizedek brings bread and wine, blesses Abram, and receives a tenth; the king of Sodom then makes a different request, which Abram refuses.
points.right: Hebrews retells the blessing and tenth, interprets royal titles, comments on genealogy, and reasons about greatness and Levi.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews explains the names as king of righteousness and king of peace

payload.tension: The interpretive meanings are explicit in Hebrews but not stated in Genesis.
payload.title: Royal titles in Genesis and Hebrews
